title: IEEE 1149.1 JTAG TAP controller: 16-state TAP, 4-bit IR, IDCODE (0x1CAF0001), BYPASS and an 8-bit USER data register

irqs.name: USER_UPDATE
irqs.desc: the debugger wrote the USER register (Update-DR with IR = USER), seen three PCLK edges later through the TCK-to-PCLK synchroniser

notes: tck, tms, tdi, trst_n and tdo are the JTAG port; they pass through unchanged. The TAP runs on tck; only the USER update event crosses into PCLK. TCK must be at most PCLK / 4 for no update to be missed.
Instructions: 0001 IDCODE (selected in Test-Logic-Reset), 0010 USER, others BYPASS. IR capture is 0101.

The update event is a toggle in the tck domain that PCLK compares with its own copy. PRESETN clears only the PCLK copy, so after an odd number of USER updates a PRESETN reset (without trst_n) reports one USER_UPDATE when it ends.
